qualifications: Local16g query/ingestion cohort, not the declared128GiB stress profile or whole application pipeline.
Original512MiB and1500/3000ms comparison guards remain unchanged; their failures are not automatically capacity failures.
5000/10000ms stress latency targets are a reference only, not native-profile acceptance.
Successful-read throughput includes workload drain; failed request durations are reported separately.
CH cgroup memory includes file cache; observed process RSS and swap are separate. Client Go and complete PG resources are not included in that CH value.
DB resource samples cover arrival start through tagged request drain; seed/oracle setup is excluded. IO remains perdevice, not summed across storage layers.
One read persecond and200 finding observations persecond are this probe's arrivals, not the full stress profile's80HTTP arrivals/second.
Three catch-up pairs; one settled diagnostic pair. Normal merges leave different physical part/row counts, retained per run.
Full5m-finding/100m-membership pipeline, native128GiB profile and24h soak remain unaccepted.
No deadline failure counts as a successful fast response.
